source.text: וְאִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נִשְׁבַּ֥ע בַּמִּצְפָּ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ לֹא־יִתֵּ֥ן בִּתּ֛וֹ לְבִנְיָמִ֖ן לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] man of Israel had sworn at Mizpah, saying, a man of us not will give his daughter to Benjamin for a wife.

en.L: And the men of Israel had sworn at Mizpah, saying, "Not one of us shall give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife."
en.B: Now the men of Israel had taken an oath at Mizpah: "None of us will give his daughter in marriage to a man of Benjamin."
en.R: Earlier, at Mizpah, the men of Israel had made a promise with an oath. They had said, "None of us will let his daughter marry a man from the tribe of Benjamin."

sw.L: Nao watu wa Israeli walikuwa wameapa huko Mizpa, wakisema, "Hakuna hata mmoja wetu atakayempa Benyamini binti yake kuwa mke."
sw.B: Basi watu wa Israeli walikuwa wameapa huko Mizpa: "Hakuna hata mmoja wetu atakayemwoza binti yake kwa mtu wa Benyamini."
sw.R: Kabla ya hapo, huko Mizpa, watu wa Israeli walikuwa wameahidi kwa kiapo. Walikuwa wamesema, "Hakuna hata mmoja wetu atakayemruhusu binti yake aolewe na mtu wa kabila la Benyamini."

es.L: Y los hombres de Israel habían jurado en Mizpa, diciendo: «Ninguno de nosotros dará su hija a Benjamín por mujer».
es.B: Los hombres de Israel habían hecho un juramento en Mizpa: «Ninguno de nosotros dará su hija en matrimonio a un hombre de Benjamín».
es.R: Antes, en Mizpa, los hombres de Israel habían hecho una promesa con juramento. Habían dicho: «Ninguno de nosotros dejará que su hija se case con un hombre de la tribu de Benjamín».

fr.L: Et les hommes d’Israël avaient juré à Mitspa, en disant : « Aucun de nous ne donnera sa fille pour femme à Benjamin. »
fr.B: Or les hommes d’Israël avaient prêté serment à Mitspa : « Aucun de nous ne donnera sa fille en mariage à un homme de Benjamin. »
fr.R: Auparavant, à Mitspa, les hommes d’Israël avaient fait une promesse avec un serment. Ils avaient dit : « Aucun de nous ne laissera sa fille épouser un homme de la tribu de Benjamin. »

vi.L: Những người Y-sơ-ra-ên đã thề tại Mích-pa rằng: "Không ai trong chúng ta sẽ gả con gái mình cho Bên-gia-min làm vợ."
vi.B: Những người Y-sơ-ra-ên đã thề tại Mích-pa: "Không ai trong chúng ta sẽ gả con gái mình cho một người Bên-gia-min."
vi.R: Trước đó, tại Mích-pa, những người Y-sơ-ra-ên đã thề hứa. Họ đã nói: "Không ai trong chúng ta sẽ để con gái mình lấy một người thuộc chi tộc Bên-gia-min."

ko.L: 이스라엘 사람들이 미스바에서 맹세하여 말했었다. "우리 가운데 아무도 자기 딸을 베냐민에게 아내로 주지 않겠다."
ko.B: 이스라엘 사람들은 미스바에서 이렇게 맹세했었다. "우리 가운데 아무도 자기 딸을 베냐민 사람에게 시집보내지 않겠다."
ko.R: 전에 미스바에서 이스라엘 사람들은 맹세하며 약속했었다. 그들은 "우리 가운데 아무도 자기 딸을 베냐민 지파 남자와 결혼시키지 않겠다" 하고 말했었다.

decisions.choice: had sworn: an oath made earlier, at the gathering in Mizpah
decisions.reason: The verb looks back. Chapter 20 tells of the gathering at Mizpah (20:1-11) but does not report this oath; it is told now because the story turns on it. Everything in this chapter is an attempt to keep the oath and still save the tribe.

decisions.choice: the man of Israel: the men of Israel together, the fighting men of the assembly
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the singular "man" for the whole body of Israelite men, as in 20:11 ("all the men of Israel ... as one man"). Those who swore are the fathers who could give daughters in marriage.

decisions.choice: give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife: refuse all marriage with the tribe
decisions.reason: Fathers arranged their daughters' marriages, so the oath shut Benjamin out of marriage with every other tribe. With Benjamin's own women killed (20:48; 21:16), the oath meant the tribe would die out.

decisions.choice: to a man of Benjamin / to a man from the tribe of Benjamin
decisions.reason: "Benjamin" here is the tribe, and in practice its surviving men; Balanced and Readable say so. Readable also adds "Earlier" to show the oath came before the events just told.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֤א הָעָם֙ בֵּֽית־אֵ֔ל וַיֵּ֤שְׁבוּ שָׁם֙ עַד־הָעֶ֔רֶב לִפְנֵ֖י הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּשְׂא֣וּ קוֹלָ֔ם וַיִּבְכּ֖וּ בְּכִ֥י גָדֽוֹל׃

records.literal_gloss: And came the people [to] Bethel, and they sat there until the evening before the God, and they lifted up their voice and they wept [a] great weeping.

en.L: And the people came to Bethel and sat there until evening before God, and they lifted up their voices and wept with great weeping.
en.B: The people went to Bethel and sat there before God until evening, weeping aloud and bitterly.
en.R: The people went to Bethel. They sat there in front of God until evening, crying loudly and bitterly.

sw.L: Nao watu wakafika Betheli, wakaketi huko mpaka jioni mbele za Mungu, wakapaza sauti zao, wakalia kilio kikuu.
sw.B: Watu walikwenda Betheli, wakaketi huko mbele za Mungu mpaka jioni, wakilia kwa sauti kubwa na kwa uchungu.
sw.R: Watu walikwenda Betheli. Waliketi huko mbele za Mungu mpaka jioni, wakilia kwa sauti kubwa na kwa uchungu.

es.L: Y vino el pueblo a Betel y se sentó allí hasta la tarde delante de Dios, y alzaron su voz y lloraron con gran llanto.
es.B: El pueblo fue a Betel y se quedó allí sentado delante de Dios hasta la tarde, llorando a gritos y con amargura.
es.R: El pueblo fue a Betel. Se sentaron allí delante de Dios hasta la tarde, llorando a gritos y con amargura.

fr.L: Et le peuple vint à Béthel, et ils restèrent assis là jusqu’au soir devant Dieu, et ils élevèrent la voix et pleurèrent de grands pleurs.
fr.B: Le peuple se rendit à Béthel et resta assis là devant Dieu jusqu’au soir, en pleurant à grands cris, amèrement.
fr.R: Le peuple est allé à Béthel. Ils sont restés assis là devant Dieu jusqu’au soir, et ils pleuraient très fort, avec beaucoup de tristesse.

vi.L: Dân chúng đến Bê-tên và ngồi đó trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời cho đến chiều, cất tiếng khóc lớn.
vi.B: Dân chúng đến Bê-tên và ngồi đó trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời cho đến chiều, khóc lóc thảm thiết.
vi.R: Dân chúng đi đến Bê-tên. Họ ngồi đó trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời cho đến chiều, khóc lớn tiếng và đau đớn.

ko.L: 백성이 벧엘로 가서 저녁까지 거기에서 하나님 앞에 앉아, 목소리를 높여 크게 울었다.
ko.B: 백성은 벧엘로 가서 저녁까지 하나님 앞에 앉아 소리 높여 슬피 울었다.
ko.R: 백성은 벧엘로 갔다. 그들은 저녁까지 하나님 앞에 앉아서 큰 소리로 슬피 울었다.

decisions.choice: Bethel, before God: at the place where the ark of the covenant then stood
decisions.reason: In this war the Israelites went up to Bethel to ask God for guidance, because the ark was there with Phinehas the priest (20:18, 26-28). To sit "before God" is to be at his sanctuary, in his presence.

decisions.choice: lifted up their voices and wept with great weeping: loud, bitter mourning
decisions.reason: Raising the voice and weeping is the sign of deep grief (2:4; 20:23, 26). Here the people mourn the loss of a tribe, though it was their own army that destroyed it (20:48).

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ לָמָ֗ה יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הָ֥יְתָה זֹּ֖את בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְהִפָּקֵ֥ד הַיּ֛וֹם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֵׁ֥בֶט אֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said, why, YHWH God of Israel, has happened this in Israel, to be missing today from Israel tribe one?

en.L: And they said, "Why, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, God of Israel, has this happened in Israel, that today one tribe should be missing from Israel?"
en.B: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, God of Israel," they cried, "why has this happened in Israel? Why should Israel be missing one of its tribes today?"
en.R: They prayed, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, God of Israel, why has this happened in Israel? Why is one tribe missing from Israel today?"

sw.L: Wakasema, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa nini jambo hili limetukia katika Israeli, hata leo kabila moja likosekane katika Israeli?"
sw.B: Walilia, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa nini jambo hili limetukia katika Israeli? Kwa nini leo Israeli likose kabila lake moja?"
sw.R: Waliomba, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa nini jambo hili limetukia katika Israeli? Kwa nini kabila moja limepotea katika Israeli leo?"

es.L: Y dijeron: «¿Por qué, oh {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, ha sucedido esto en Israel, que falte hoy de Israel una tribu?».
es.B: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel —clamaban—, ¿por qué ha sucedido esto en Israel? ¿Por qué ha de faltarle hoy a Israel una de sus tribus?».
es.R: Oraron así: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, ¿por qué ha pasado esto en Israel? ¿Por qué falta hoy una tribu en Israel?».

fr.L: Et ils dirent : « Pourquoi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël, cela est-il arrivé en Israël, qu’il manque aujourd’hui à Israël une tribu ? »
fr.B: « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël, s’écrièrent-ils, pourquoi cela est-il arrivé en Israël ? Pourquoi manque-t-il aujourd’hui une tribu à Israël ? »
fr.R: Ils ont prié : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël, pourquoi cela est-il arrivé en Israël ? Pourquoi manque-t-il une tribu à Israël aujourd’hui ? »

vi.L: Họ nói: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, sao điều này lại xảy ra trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, để hôm nay Y-sơ-ra-ên thiếu mất một chi tộc?"
vi.B: Họ kêu lên: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, sao điều này lại xảy ra trong Y-sơ-ra-ên? Sao hôm nay Y-sơ-ra-ên lại phải mất một chi tộc?"
vi.R: Họ cầu nguyện: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, sao điều này lại xảy ra trong Y-sơ-ra-ên? Sao hôm nay Y-sơ-ra-ên lại thiếu mất một chi tộc?"

ko.L: 그들이 말했다. "이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 어찌하여 이스라엘에 이런 일이 일어나서, 오늘 이스라엘에서 한 지파가 없어지게 되었습니까?"
ko.B: 그들이 부르짖었다. "이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 어찌하여 이스라엘에 이런 일이 일어났습니까? 어찌하여 오늘 이스라엘에서 한 지파가 없어져야 합니까?"
ko.R: 그들이 기도했다. "이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 왜 이스라엘에 이런 일이 일어났습니까? 왜 오늘 이스라엘에서 한 지파가 없어졌습니까?"

decisions.choice: Why has this happened? A lament that brings the loss before God
decisions.reason: The question is a cry of grief, not a request for information. The answer is plain from the story: Benjamin protected the men of Gibeah (20:13), and Israel's army destroyed the tribe's towns and people (20:48) and swore the oath of verse 1. The people speak as if the disaster had simply come on them.

decisions.choice: be missing: be counted and found lacking
decisions.reason: The verb belongs to the language of counting. When Israel is counted, one tribe will be absent. The same root is used for the muster in verse 9.

decisions.choice: prayed
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "they said". The words are addressed to God, so Readable says they prayed.

decisions.choice: "주여" (the divine name span with the vocative "여" after it)
decisions.reason: In prayer the divine name is called on directly; the vocative ending stays outside the span so that both readings, "주여" and "야훼여", work.

source.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ הָעָ֔ם וַיִּבְנוּ־שָׁ֖ם מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיַּעֲל֥וּ עֹל֖וֹת וּשְׁלָמִֽים׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And it was on the next day, and rose early the people, and they built there an altar, and they offered up burnt offerings and peace offerings.

en.L: And it happened on the next day that the people rose early and built an altar there, and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
en.B: Early the next morning the people built an altar there and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
en.R: Early the next morning the people built an altar there. They offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

sw.L: Ikawa siku iliyofuata watu wakaamka mapema, wakajenga madhabahu huko, wakatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani.
sw.B: Asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata watu walijenga madhabahu huko, wakatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani.
sw.R: Asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata watu walijenga madhabahu huko. Walitoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani.

es.L: Y sucedió al día siguiente que el pueblo madrugó y edificó allí un altar, y ofrecieron holocaustos y sacrificios de paz.
es.B: Al día siguiente, muy temprano, el pueblo edificó allí un altar y ofreció holocaustos y sacrificios de paz.
es.R: Al día siguiente, muy temprano, el pueblo construyó allí un altar. Ofrecieron holocaustos y sacrificios de paz.

fr.L: Et il arriva le lendemain que le peuple se leva tôt et bâtit là un autel, et ils offrirent des holocaustes et des sacrifices de communion.
fr.B: Le lendemain, de bon matin, le peuple bâtit là un autel et offrit des holocaustes et des sacrifices de communion.
fr.R: Le lendemain, tôt le matin, le peuple a construit un autel à cet endroit. Ils ont offert des holocaustes et des sacrifices de communion.

vi.L: Hôm sau, dân chúng dậy sớm và xây một bàn thờ tại đó, rồi dâng tế lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an.
vi.B: Sáng sớm hôm sau, dân chúng xây một bàn thờ tại đó và dâng tế lễ thiêu cùng tế lễ bình an.
vi.R: Sáng sớm hôm sau, dân chúng xây một bàn thờ tại đó. Họ dâng tế lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an.

ko.L: 이튿날 백성이 일찍 일어나 거기에 제단을 쌓고 번제와 화목제를 드렸다.
ko.B: 이튿날 아침 일찍 백성은 거기에 제단을 쌓고 번제와 화목제를 드렸다.
ko.R: 이튿날 아침 일찍 백성은 거기에 제단을 쌓았다. 그리고 번제와 화목제를 드렸다.

decisions.choice: built an altar there: a new altar at Bethel for this occasion
decisions.reason: Israel had already offered sacrifices at Bethel during the war (20:26). Why a new altar was needed is not said; the narrator records only that the people built one before seeking a way out of their oath.

decisions.choice: burnt offerings and peace offerings: seeking God's favor in a time of crisis
decisions.reason: A burnt offering was burned whole for the LORD (Leviticus 1); a peace offering was shared in a meal before him (Leviticus 3). The same pair is offered at Bethel in 20:26, after the second defeat, and by Saul before battle in 1 Samuel 13:9.

source.text: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ֠י אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־עָלָ֧ה בַקָּהָ֛ל מִכָּל־שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־יְהוָ֑ה כִּי֩ הַשְּׁבוּעָ֨ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֜ה הָיְתָ֗ה לַ֠אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָ֨ה אֶל־יְהוָ֧ה הַמִּצְפָּ֛ה לֵאמֹ֖ר מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And said [the] sons of Israel, who [is there] who not went up in the assembly from all [the] tribes of Israel to YHWH? For the oath the great had been concerning whoever not went up to YHWH [to] the Mizpah, saying, surely he shall be put to death.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel said, "Who [is there] among all the tribes of Israel who did not come up in the assembly to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?" For the great oath had been concerning whoever did not come up to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Mizpah, saying, "He shall surely be put to death."
en.B: Then the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} asked, "Is there anyone from all the tribes of Israel who did not come up with the assembly to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?" For they had bound themselves by a solemn oath: whoever stayed away from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Mizpah must be put to death.
en.R: Then the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} asked, "Did anyone from the tribes of Israel fail to come to the gathering before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?" They asked because they had made a serious promise with an oath: anyone who did not come to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Mizpah would be put to death.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Israeli wakasema, "Ni nani katika makabila yote ya Israeli asiyepanda katika kusanyiko kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?" Kwa maana kiapo kikuu kilikuwa juu ya yeyote asiyepanda kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Mizpa, kikisema, "Hakika atauawa."
sw.B: Kisha Waisraeli waliuliza, "Je, kuna yeyote katika makabila yote ya Israeli ambaye hakupanda pamoja na kusanyiko kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?" Kwa maana walikuwa wamejifunga kwa kiapo kizito kwamba yeyote ambaye hangepanda kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Mizpa lazima auawe.
sw.R: Kisha Waisraeli waliuliza, "Je, kuna mtu yeyote kutoka makabila ya Israeli ambaye hakuja kwenye mkutano mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?" Waliuliza hivyo kwa sababu walikuwa wameahidi kwa kiapo kizito kwamba yeyote ambaye hangekuja kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Mizpa angeuawa.

es.L: Y dijeron los hijos de Israel: «¿Quién [hay] de entre todas las tribus de Israel que no subió en la asamblea {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}?». Porque se había hecho el gran juramento acerca de quien no subiera {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} a Mizpa, diciendo: «Ciertamente morirá».
es.B: Entonces los israelitas preguntaron: «¿Hay alguno de entre todas las tribus de Israel que no haya subido con la asamblea {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}?». Porque se habían comprometido con un juramento solemne: el que no se presentara {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en Mizpa debía morir.
es.R: Entonces los israelitas preguntaron: «¿Hubo alguien de las tribus de Israel que no vino a la reunión delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?». Lo preguntaban porque habían hecho una promesa seria con juramento: cualquiera que no viniera {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en Mizpa tendría que morir.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël dirent : « Qui [est-ce] qui n’est pas monté dans l’assemblée, d’entre toutes les tribus d’Israël, vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? » Car le grand serment avait été au sujet de celui qui ne monterait pas vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Mitspa, en disant : « Il sera certainement mis à mort. »
fr.B: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} demandèrent alors : « Y a-t-il quelqu’un, parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël, qui ne soit pas monté avec l’assemblée vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? » Car ils s’étaient engagés par un serment solennel : quiconque ne monterait pas vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Mitspa serait mis à mort.
fr.R: Alors les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont demandé : « Est-ce que quelqu’un des tribus d’Israël n’est pas venu à la réunion devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? » Ils demandaient cela parce qu’ils avaient fait une promesse sérieuse avec un serment : celui qui ne viendrait pas devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Mitspa serait mis à mort.

vi.L: Con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên nói: "Trong tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, ai là người đã không đi lên hội cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}?" Vì họ đã thề một lời thề lớn về bất cứ ai không đi lên cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Mích-pa, rằng: "Người ấy chắc chắn phải bị xử tử."
vi.B: Bấy giờ dân Y-sơ-ra-ên hỏi: "Trong tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, có ai đã không cùng hội chúng đi lên với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không?" Vì họ đã thề một lời thề nghiêm trọng: ai không đi lên với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Mích-pa sẽ phải bị xử tử.
vi.R: Bấy giờ dân Y-sơ-ra-ên hỏi: "Trong các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, có ai đã không đến buổi họp trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không?" Họ hỏi vậy vì họ đã thề hứa một cách nghiêm trọng: ai không đến với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Mích-pa sẽ bị xử tử.

ko.L: 이스라엘 자손이 말했다. "이스라엘 모든 지파 가운데 총회와 함께 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 올라오지 않은 자가 누구냐?" 미스바로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 올라오지 않는 자에 대하여 "그는 반드시 죽임을 당할 것이다" 하는 큰 맹세가 있었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 물었다. "이스라엘 모든 지파 가운데 총회와 함께 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 올라오지 않은 사람이 있느냐?" 그들은 미스바로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 올라오지 않는 사람은 반드시 죽이기로 엄숙하게 맹세했었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그리고 이스라엘 백성이 물었다. "이스라엘 지파들 가운데 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 모이는 자리에 오지 않은 사람이 있느냐?" 그들이 이렇게 물은 것은, 미스바로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 오지 않는 사람은 죽이기로 엄숙하게 맹세했었기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: the great oath: a second oath, made at Mizpah, against anyone who stayed away
decisions.reason: Besides the oath of verse 1, the assembly had sworn that anyone who refused the call to Mizpah (20:1) would die. A summons to the tribes in a time of war carried such a threat; compare Saul's summons in 1 Samuel 11:7. The oath is what gives the assembly a reason to attack Jabesh-gilead (verses 8-10).

decisions.choice: he shall surely be put to death: the legal formula for a death sentence
decisions.reason: The doubled verb is the form the law uses for crimes that carry the death penalty (Exodus 21:12, 15-17; Leviticus 20:2). It is emphatic: the penalty must be carried out.

decisions.choice: For the great oath had been: the narrator explains the question
decisions.reason: The question about who stayed away is not idle; the narrator adds the reason. The verb looks back to the gathering at Mizpah, like "had sworn" in verse 1.

decisions.choice: the oath reported, not quoted
alternatives: "He shall surely be put to death"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the oath's own words in quotation marks. Balanced and Readable report it in the narrator's words, which reads more easily inside an explanation; Readable also says "They asked because" for the Hebrew "for".

fr.R: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} avaient pitié de la tribu de Benjamin, parce que les gens de Benjamin étaient de leur propre famille. Ils ont dit : « Aujourd’hui, une tribu a été coupée d’Israël.

vi.L: Con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên thương xót Bên-gia-min, anh em mình, và nói: "Hôm nay một chi tộc đã bị chặt khỏi Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Nhưng dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đau lòng vì chi tộc anh em mình là Bên-gia-min. Họ nói: "Hôm nay một chi tộc đã bị chặt khỏi Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên thấy thương chi tộc Bên-gia-min, vì người Bên-gia-min là bà con của họ. Họ nói: "Hôm nay một chi tộc đã bị chặt khỏi Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 이스라엘 자손은 그들의 형제 베냐민을 불쌍히 여겨 말했다. "오늘 이스라엘에서 한 지파가 잘려 나갔다.
ko.B: 그러나 이스라엘 자손은 형제 지파인 베냐민 때문에 마음 아파하며 말했다. "오늘 이스라엘에서 한 지파가 잘려 나갔다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성은 베냐민 지파를 불쌍히 여겼다. 베냐민 사람들도 그들의 친척이었기 때문이다. 그들이 말했다. "오늘 이스라엘에서 한 지파가 잘려 나갔다.

decisions.choice: had compassion: grieved and felt pity, enough to want to act
decisions.reason: The verb can mean to be sorry, to grieve, to be comforted, or to change one's mind. Here Israel grieves over what has happened to Benjamin, and the grief leads to the search for wives that follows. The same verb comes back in verse 15.

decisions.choice: Benjamin his brother: a brother tribe, descended from the same father
decisions.reason: The tribes were the families of Jacob's sons, and Benjamin was the youngest (Genesis 35:18). The Hebrew says "his brother", treating Israel as one person. In the war itself the Israelites had called Benjamin "my brother" (20:23, 28).

decisions.choice: cut off: hewn off, like a branch chopped from a tree
decisions.reason: The verb is used for cutting down trees and cutting off a horn or a limb. Only 600 men of Benjamin were left (20:47); the tribe is cut away from the people as a whole.

decisions.choice: because the people of Benjamin were their own relatives
decisions.reason: Readable explains "their brother": the tribes were related families.

en.B: How can we provide wives for the men who are left, since we have sworn by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} not to give them any of our daughters in marriage?"
en.R: The men who are left have no wives. How can we find wives for them? We swore by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that we would not let them marry our daughters."

es.B: ¿Cómo conseguiremos esposas para los hombres que han quedado, si hemos jurado por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no darles en matrimonio a ninguna de nuestras hijas?».
es.R: Los hombres que han quedado no tienen esposas. ¿Cómo podemos conseguirles esposas? Juramos por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} que no dejaríamos que se casaran con nuestras hijas».

fr.L: Que ferons-nous pour eux, pour ceux qui restent, pour [leur trouver] des femmes, puisque nous, nous avons juré par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de ne pas leur donner de nos filles pour femmes ? »
fr.B: Comment fournir des femmes aux hommes qui restent, puisque nous avons juré par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de ne pas leur donner nos filles en mariage ? »
fr.R: Les hommes qui restent n’ont pas de femmes. Comment leur trouver des femmes ? Nous avons juré par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} que nous ne les laisserions pas épouser nos filles. »

vi.B: Làm sao chúng ta có thể lo vợ cho những người còn sót lại, vì chúng ta đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà thề không gả con gái mình cho họ?"
vi.R: Những người còn sống sót không có vợ. Làm sao chúng ta tìm được vợ cho họ? Chúng ta đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà thề không để họ cưới con gái chúng ta."

ko.B: 우리가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두고 우리 딸들을 그들에게 아내로 주지 않겠다고 맹세하였으니, 살아남은 사람들에게 어떻게 아내를 얻어 줄 수 있겠느냐?"
ko.R: 살아남은 사람들에게는 아내가 없다. 어떻게 하면 그들에게 아내를 구해 줄 수 있겠느냐? 우리는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두고 우리 딸들을 그들과 결혼시키지 않겠다고 맹세하였다."

decisions.choice: those who remain: the 600 men of Benjamin at the rock of Rimmon
decisions.reason: Only 600 men escaped the battle and fled to the rock of Rimmon (20:47). Israel's army had then killed everyone in Benjamin's towns (20:48), so the survivors had no wives and no women of their own tribe left (verse 16).

decisions.choice: we have sworn by the LORD: an oath that cannot simply be broken
decisions.reason: An oath made in the LORD's name bound the one who swore it (Numbers 30:3; Deuteronomy 23:22-24). The assembly's own oath now stands in the way of saving the tribe, and the rest of the chapter is spent finding ways around it.

decisions.choice: The men who are left have no wives.
alternatives: What shall we do for them ... for wives
decisions.reason: Readable states the problem first in its own sentence, then asks the question.

records.literal_gloss: And they said, who [is] one from [the] tribes of Israel which not went up to YHWH [to] the Mizpah? And behold, not had come a man to the camp from Jabesh-gilead, to the assembly.

en.L: And they said, "Which one of the tribes of Israel did not come up to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Mizpah?" And look, no one had come to the camp from Jabesh-gilead, to the assembly.
en.B: So they asked, "Who from the tribes of Israel did not come up to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Mizpah?" It turned out that not a single man from Jabesh-gilead had come into the camp to join the assembly.
en.R: So they asked, "Which group from the tribes of Israel did not come to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Mizpah?" They found out that no one from the town of Jabesh-gilead had come to the camp for the gathering.

sw.L: Nao wakasema, "Ni lipi katika makabila ya Israeli ambalo halikupanda kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Mizpa?" Na tazama, hakuna mtu aliyekuja kambini kutoka Yabeshi-gileadi, kwenye kusanyiko.
sw.B: Basi waliuliza, "Ni nani katika makabila ya Israeli ambaye hakupanda kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Mizpa?" Ikaonekana kwamba hakuna hata mtu mmoja kutoka Yabeshi-gileadi aliyekuja kambini kujiunga na kusanyiko.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo waliuliza, "Ni kundi gani katika makabila ya Israeli ambalo halikuja kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Mizpa?" Waligundua kwamba hakuna mtu kutoka mji wa Yabeshi-gileadi aliyekuja kambini kwa ajili ya mkutano.

es.L: Y dijeron: «¿Cuál de las tribus de Israel no subió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} a Mizpa?». Y he aquí, nadie había venido al campamento desde Jabés de Galaad, a la asamblea.
es.B: Así que preguntaron: «¿Quién de las tribus de Israel no subió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en Mizpa?». Y resultó que ni un solo hombre de Jabés de Galaad había venido al campamento para unirse a la asamblea.
es.R: Así que preguntaron: «¿Qué grupo de las tribus de Israel no vino {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en Mizpa?». Descubrieron que nadie del pueblo de Jabés de Galaad había venido al campamento para la reunión.

fr.L: Et ils dirent : « Quelle est celle des tribus d’Israël qui n’est pas montée vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Mitspa ? » Et voici, personne n’était venu au camp de Jabesh-Galaad, à l’assemblée.
fr.B: Ils demandèrent donc : « Qui, parmi les tribus d’Israël, n’est pas monté vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Mitspa ? » Or il se trouva que pas un seul homme de Jabesh-Galaad n’était venu au camp pour se joindre à l’assemblée.
fr.R: Alors ils ont demandé : « Quel groupe des tribus d’Israël n’est pas venu devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Mitspa ? » Ils ont découvert que personne de la ville de Jabesh-Galaad n’était venu au camp pour la réunion.

vi.L: Họ nói: "Trong các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, có ai đã không đi lên cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Mích-pa?" Và kìa, không có ai từ Gia-be Ga-la-át đến trại, đến hội.
vi.B: Vậy họ hỏi: "Trong các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, ai đã không đi lên với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Mích-pa?" Thì ra không có một người nào từ Gia-be Ga-la-át đến trại để dự hội.
vi.R: Vậy họ hỏi: "Trong các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, nhóm nào đã không đến với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Mích-pa?" Họ phát hiện ra rằng không có ai từ thành Gia-be Ga-la-át đến trại để dự buổi họp.

ko.L: 그들이 말했다. "이스라엘 지파 가운데 미스바로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 올라오지 않은 곳이 어디냐?" 보라, 야베스 길르앗에서는 아무도 진영에, 곧 총회에 오지 않았다.
ko.B: 그래서 그들은 "이스라엘 지파 가운데 미스바로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 올라오지 않은 곳이 어디냐?" 하고 물었다. 알아보니, 야베스 길르앗에서는 한 사람도 진영에 와서 총회에 참석하지 않았다.
ko.R: 그래서 그들은 "이스라엘 지파 가운데 미스바로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 오지 않은 무리가 있느냐?" 하고 물었다. 알아보니, 야베스 길르앗 성에서는 아무도 그 모임에 오지 않았다.

decisions.choice: Jabesh-gilead: an Israelite town in Gilead, east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Jabesh lay in Gilead, in the land of the eastern tribes. The town appears again in Saul's story: Saul, a Benjaminite, rescues it from the Ammonites, and its men later bury Saul (1 Samuel 11:1-11; 31:11-13). The link between Jabesh and Benjamin begins here.

decisions.choice: look: the word marks a discovery
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word draws attention to what is found: no one from Jabesh-gilead had answered the summons. That finding brings the oath of verse 5 into force.

decisions.choice: It turned out that / They found out that
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the Hebrew "look" signals here, a discovery. Readable adds "the town of" so the name is not taken for a tribe.

decisions.choice: "Jabés de Galaad", "Silo", "Lebona", "Siquem"
decisions.reason: The names in their usual Spanish forms; Shiloh and Shechem as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "Jabesh-Galaad"
decisions.reason: The town's name is joined to Gilead with a hyphen, as the English "Jabesh-gilead" and the Hebrew are, and Gilead keeps its usual French form "Galaad"; "sh" writes the shin, as elsewhere in this block.

decisions.choice: "Gia-be Ga-la-át" for Jabesh-gilead
decisions.reason: A name first used in this block; the town keeps the "Ga-la-át" used for Gilead throughout.

source.text: וַיִּתְפָּקֵ֖ד הָעָ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵֽין־שָׁם֙ אִ֔ישׁ מִיּוֹשְׁבֵ֖י יָבֵ֥שׁ גִּלְעָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And was mustered the people, and behold, not there [was] a man from [the] inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead.

en.L: For the people were counted, and look, there was not a man there from the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead.
en.B: When the people were counted, not one of those who lived in Jabesh-gilead was there.
en.R: They counted the people, and no one from Jabesh-gilead was there.

sw.L: Kwa maana watu walihesabiwa, na tazama, hapakuwa na mtu huko katika wenyeji wa Yabeshi-gileadi.
sw.B: Watu walipohesabiwa, hakuna hata mmoja wa wenyeji wa Yabeshi-gileadi aliyekuwepo.
sw.R: Waliwahesabu watu, na hakuna mtu kutoka Yabeshi-gileadi aliyekuwepo.

es.L: Porque fue contado el pueblo, y he aquí, no había allí ningún hombre de los habitantes de Jabés de Galaad.
es.B: Cuando se contó al pueblo, no estaba allí ninguno de los habitantes de Jabés de Galaad.
es.R: Contaron a la gente, y nadie de Jabés de Galaad estaba allí.

fr.L: Car le peuple fut recensé, et voici, il n’y avait là personne des habitants de Jabesh-Galaad.
fr.B: Quand on fit le recensement du peuple, aucun des habitants de Jabesh-Galaad n’était là.
fr.R: On a compté les gens, et personne de Jabesh-Galaad n’était là.

vi.L: Vì dân chúng được kiểm điểm, và kìa, không có một người nào trong dân cư Gia-be Ga-la-át ở đó.
vi.B: Khi kiểm điểm dân chúng, thì không có một người nào ở Gia-be Ga-la-át có mặt.
vi.R: Họ đếm dân chúng, và không có ai từ Gia-be Ga-la-át ở đó.

ko.L: 백성을 세어 보니, 보라, 야베스 길르앗 주민은 한 사람도 거기에 없었다.
ko.B: 백성을 세어 보니, 야베스 길르앗에 사는 사람은 한 사람도 거기에 없었다.
ko.R: 그들이 백성을 세어 보니, 야베스 길르앗에서 온 사람은 아무도 없었다.

decisions.choice: the people were counted: how the discovery of verse 8 was made
decisions.reason: The verse goes back over what verse 8 has just said and tells how it was found: the army was counted, as troops were mustered for war, and no one from Jabesh-gilead answered. The verb is from the same root as "be missing" in verse 3.

decisions.choice: For
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "and". Literal says "For" because the verse explains the one before it rather than adding a new event.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ־שָׁ֣ם הָעֵדָ֗ה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֣י הֶחָ֑יִל וַיְצַוּ֨וּ אוֹתָ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר לְ֠כוּ וְהִכִּיתֶ֞ם אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵ֨י יָבֵ֤שׁ גִּלְעָד֙ לְפִי־חֶ֔רֶב וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַטָּֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent there the congregation twelve thousand men from the sons of the strength, and they commanded them, saying, go and strike [the] inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead to [the] mouth of [the] sword, and the women and the little ones.

en.L: And the congregation sent 12,000 men of the valiant there and commanded them, saying, "Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, even the women and the little ones.
en.B: So the congregation sent 12,000 of its best fighting men there with these orders: "Go and put the people of Jabesh-gilead to the sword, the women and children too.
en.R: The community sent 12,000 of its best soldiers there. They gave them this order: "Go and kill everyone who lives in Jabesh-gilead, even the women and children.

sw.L: Nayo jumuiya ikatuma huko watu 12,000 wa wale hodari, ikawaamuru, ikisema, "Nendeni mkawapige wenyeji wa Yabeshi-gileadi kwa makali ya upanga, hata wanawake na watoto wadogo.
sw.B: Basi jumuiya ilituma huko watu 12,000 wa wapiganaji wake bora wakiwa na amri hii: "Nendeni mkawaue kwa upanga watu wa Yabeshi-gileadi, pamoja na wanawake na watoto.
sw.R: Jumuiya ilituma huko askari wake bora 12,000. Iliwapa amri hii: "Nendeni mkamwue kila mtu anayeishi Yabeshi-gileadi, hata wanawake na watoto.

es.L: Y la comunidad envió allá 12 000 hombres de los valientes, y les mandó, diciendo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:hieran|herid}} a filo de espada a los habitantes de Jabés de Galaad, también a las mujeres y a los pequeños.
es.B: Así que la comunidad envió allá a 12 000 de sus mejores guerreros con esta orden: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:pasen|pasad}} a espada a la gente de Jabés de Galaad, también a las mujeres y a los niños.
es.R: La comunidad envió allá a 12 000 de sus mejores soldados. Les dieron esta orden: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:maten|matad}} a todos los que viven en Jabés de Galaad, incluso a las mujeres y a los niños.

fr.L: Et la communauté envoya là 12 000 hommes d’entre les vaillants et leur donna cet ordre : « Allez, et frappez les habitants de Jabesh-Galaad du tranchant de l’épée, même les femmes et les petits enfants.
fr.B: La communauté y envoya donc 12 000 de ses meilleurs guerriers avec cet ordre : « Allez passer au fil de l’épée les habitants de Jabesh-Galaad, les femmes et les enfants aussi.
fr.R: La communauté a envoyé là-bas 12 000 de ses meilleurs soldats. Elle leur a donné cet ordre : « Allez tuer tous les habitants de Jabesh-Galaad, même les femmes et les enfants.

vi.L: Hội chúng sai 12.000 người dũng mãnh đến đó và truyền lệnh cho họ: "Hãy đi dùng lưỡi gươm đánh dân cư Gia-be Ga-la-át, kể cả đàn bà và con nhỏ.
vi.B: Vậy hội chúng sai 12.000 chiến binh giỏi nhất đến đó với mệnh lệnh: "Hãy đi dùng gươm giết dân Gia-be Ga-la-át, cả đàn bà và trẻ con.
vi.R: Cộng đồng sai 12.000 lính giỏi nhất đến đó. Họ ra lệnh: "Hãy đi giết mọi người sống ở Gia-be Ga-la-át, kể cả đàn bà và trẻ con.

ko.L: 그래서 회중이 용사 만 이천 명을 그리로 보내며 그들에게 명령하였다. "가서 야베스 길르앗 주민을 칼날로 쳐라. 여자들과 어린아이들도 쳐라.
ko.B: 그래서 회중은 가장 용감한 군사 만 이천 명을 그리로 보내며 이렇게 명령하였다. "가서 야베스 길르앗 주민을 칼로 쳐 죽여라. 여자들과 아이들도 죽여라.
ko.R: 그래서 공동체는 가장 뛰어난 군인 만 이천 명을 그리로 보냈다. 그들은 군인들에게 이렇게 명령했다. "가서 야베스 길르앗에 사는 사람들을 모두 죽여라. 여자들과 아이들까지 죽여라.

decisions.choice: the sons of strength: capable, proven warriors
decisions.reason: "Sons of" a quality are people marked by it. "Strength" here is strength in battle, so these are the army's best fighting men (compare 20:44, 46).

decisions.choice: with the edge of the sword: kill in battle
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "to the mouth of the sword", the blade pictured as a mouth that devours. The phrase means to kill with the sword (1:8, 25; 20:37, 48).

decisions.choice: even the women and the little ones: the death sentence of the oath widened to a whole town
decisions.reason: The oath of verse 5 threatened death to anyone who stayed away. Now the assembly turns it against an entire Israelite town, families included, in part to find wives. The narrator reports it without praise and closes the book with the verdict of verse 25.

decisions.choice: children
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means "little ones", the young children of a household. Balanced and Readable say "children"; Literal keeps "little ones".

source.text: וְזֶ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ כָּל־זָכָ֗ר וְכָל־אִשָּׁ֛ה יֹדַ֥עַת מִשְׁכַּב־זָכָ֖ר תַּחֲרִֽימוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And this [is] the thing that you shall do: every male and every woman knowing [the] lying of a male you shall devote to destruction.

en.L: And this is the thing that you shall do: every male, and every woman who has known lying with a male, you shall devote to destruction."
en.B: Here is what you must do: every male, and every woman who has slept with a man, you are to devote to destruction."
en.R: This is what you must do. Destroy completely, as given over to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, every male and every woman who has slept with a man."

sw.L: Na hili ndilo jambo mtakalofanya: kila mwanamume, na kila mwanamke aliyemjua mwanamume kwa kulala naye, mtawaweka wakfu kwa maangamizi."
sw.B: Hiki ndicho mtakachofanya: kila mwanamume, na kila mwanamke aliyewahi kulala na mwanamume, mtawaangamiza kabisa kama watu waliowekwa wakfu kwa maangamizi."
sw.R: Hiki ndicho mnachopaswa kufanya. Mwangamizeni kabisa, kama watu waliotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kila mwanamume na kila mwanamke aliyewahi kulala na mwanamume."

es.L: Y esto es lo que {{plural_you:harán|haréis}}: a todo varón, y a toda mujer que haya conocido ayuntamiento de varón, {{plural_you:consagrarán|consagraréis}} al exterminio».
es.B: Esto es lo que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} hacer: a todo varón y a toda mujer que se haya acostado con un hombre, {{plural_you:deben consagrarlos|debéis consagrarlos}} al exterminio».
es.R: Esto es lo que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} que hacer: {{plural_you:destruyan|destruid}} por completo, como algo entregado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, a todo varón y a toda mujer que se haya acostado con un hombre».

fr.L: Et voici la chose que vous ferez : tout mâle, et toute femme qui a connu la couche d’un mâle, vous les vouerez à l’interdit. »
fr.B: Voici ce que vous devez faire : vous vouerez à l’interdit tout homme, et toute femme qui a couché avec un homme. »
fr.R: Voici ce que vous devez faire : détruisez entièrement, comme une chose donnée {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, tous les hommes et toutes les femmes qui ont couché avec un homme. »

vi.L: Đây là điều các ngươi sẽ làm: mọi người nam, và mọi người nữ đã biết nằm với người nam, các ngươi sẽ tận diệt."
vi.B: Đây là điều các anh phải làm: mọi người nam và mọi người nữ đã ăn nằm với đàn ông, các anh phải tận diệt."
vi.R: Đây là điều các anh phải làm. Hãy hủy diệt hoàn toàn, như dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mọi người nam và mọi người nữ đã ăn nằm với đàn ông."

ko.L: 너희가 할 일은 이것이다. 모든 남자와 남자와 동침한 모든 여자를 진멸하여라."
ko.B: 너희가 할 일은 이것이다. 모든 남자와, 남자와 잠자리를 한 적이 있는 모든 여자를 진멸하여라."
ko.R: 너희가 할 일은 이것이다. 모든 남자와, 남자와 잠자리를 한 적이 있는 모든 여자를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바친 것으로 여겨 완전히 멸하여라."

decisions.choice: devote to destruction: give over to God by destroying completely
decisions.reason: The verb belongs to the practice of devoting something or someone to God so that it is destroyed and no one keeps it (Joshua 6:17-21). The law used it for an Israelite town that turned to other gods (Deuteronomy 13:13-19). Here it is turned against an Israelite town whose offense was staying away from the assembly, and it is not complete: the young women are spared to be wives (verse 12).

decisions.choice: every male and every woman who has known a man: the words of the war on Midian
decisions.reason: Moses ordered the army to kill every male among the children of Midian and every woman who had known a man, and to keep alive the girls who had not (Numbers 31:17-18). The assembly takes that command against foreign enemies and applies it to fellow Israelites.

decisions.choice: known the lying of a male: had sexual relations with a man
decisions.reason: "Know" is the usual Hebrew way of speaking of sexual relations (Genesis 4:1), and "the lying of a male" makes the meaning plain. The women spared are the virgins, as verse 12 says.

decisions.choice: Destroy completely, as given over to the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable explains the verb, as the Numbers-to-Ruth wording does everywhere: destruction that hands the people over to God. The LORD is not named in this verse; Readable names him because that is what the verb means.

decisions.choice: "kuweka wakfu kwa maangamizi" (devote to destruction) for the herem at Literal; Balanced adds "kuangamiza kabisa"; Readable "mwangamizeni kabisa, kama watu waliotolewa kwa BWANA"
decisions.reason: As agreed for these books in every language: the herem is destruction as a giving over to God (m1). Literal names the act; Balanced and Readable say plainly that it means destroying completely, with Readable naming the LORD as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "consagrar al exterminio" (L, B); "destruir por completo, como algo entregado al SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for the Hebrew word for what is devoted to God by being destroyed (m1): Literal and Balanced say "consagrar al exterminio", which keeps both the giving to God and the destruction; Readable says it in plain words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "vouer à l'interdit" (L, B); "détruire entièrement, comme une chose donnée au SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note for these books sets for the Hebrew word: to devote to destruction means giving a people or a town over to God by destroying it completely (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the technical French "vouer à l'interdit"; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "tận diệt" (L, B), "hủy diệt hoàn toàn, như dâng cho CHÚA" (R) for *haram*
decisions.reason: As the Joshua–Ruth terms note sets for *herem*; Readable explains that what is destroyed is given over to the LORD, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "진멸하다" at Literal and Balanced; "주께 바친 것으로 여겨 완전히 멸하다" at Readable
decisions.reason: As the terms of this translation set for *herem*. Readable adds what the English Readable adds: the destruction was counted as given over to the LORD.

source.text: וַֽיִּמְצְא֞וּ מִיּוֹשְׁבֵ֣י׀יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֗ד אַרְבַּ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ נַעֲרָ֣ה בְתוּלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־יָדְעָ֛ה אִ֖ישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ אוֹתָ֤ם אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶה֙ שִׁלֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they found from [the] inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young women, virgins, who not had known a man by lying of a male, and they brought them to the camp [at] Shiloh, which [is] in [the] land of Canaan.

en.L: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead 400 young women, virgins, who had not known a man by lying with a male; and they brought them to the camp at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
en.B: Among the people of Jabesh-gilead they found 400 young women who were virgins and had never slept with a man. These they brought to the camp at Shiloh, in the land of Canaan.
en.R: Among the people of Jabesh-gilead they found 400 young women who had never slept with a man. They took them to the Israelite camp at Shiloh, in the land of Canaan.

sw.L: Nao wakapata katika wenyeji wa Yabeshi-gileadi wasichana 400, mabikira, wasiomjua mwanamume kwa kulala naye; wakawaleta kambini huko Shilo, ulioko katika nchi ya Kanaani.
sw.B: Kati ya watu wa Yabeshi-gileadi walipata wasichana 400 waliokuwa mabikira, ambao hawakuwahi kulala na mwanamume. Hao waliwaleta kambini huko Shilo, katika nchi ya Kanaani.
sw.R: Kati ya watu wa Yabeshi-gileadi walipata wasichana 400 ambao hawakuwahi kulala na mwanamume. Waliwapeleka kwenye kambi ya Waisraeli huko Shilo, katika nchi ya Kanaani.

es.L: Y hallaron de entre los habitantes de Jabés de Galaad 400 muchachas vírgenes, que no habían conocido varón en ayuntamiento de varón; y las llevaron al campamento en Silo, que [está] en la tierra de Canaán.
es.B: Entre la gente de Jabés de Galaad encontraron 400 muchachas vírgenes, que nunca se habían acostado con un hombre. Las llevaron al campamento de Silo, en la tierra de Canaán.
es.R: Entre la gente de Jabés de Galaad encontraron 400 muchachas que nunca se habían acostado con un hombre. Las llevaron al campamento israelita de Silo, en la tierra de Canaán.

fr.L: Et ils trouvèrent parmi les habitants de Jabesh-Galaad 400 jeunes filles vierges, qui n’avaient pas connu d’homme par la couche d’un mâle ; et ils les amenèrent au camp, à Silo, qui [est] dans le pays de Canaan.
fr.B: Parmi les habitants de Jabesh-Galaad, ils trouvèrent 400 jeunes filles vierges, qui n’avaient jamais couché avec un homme. Ils les amenèrent au camp, à Silo, dans le pays de Canaan.
fr.R: Parmi les habitants de Jabesh-Galaad, ils ont trouvé 400 jeunes filles qui n’avaient jamais couché avec un homme. Ils les ont emmenées au camp des Israélites, à Silo, dans le pays de Canaan.

vi.L: Trong dân cư Gia-be Ga-la-át, họ tìm được 400 thiếu nữ còn trinh, chưa biết người nam bằng việc nằm với người nam; và họ đem những người ấy về trại tại Si-lô, ở trong xứ Ca-na-an.
vi.B: Trong dân Gia-be Ga-la-át, họ tìm được 400 thiếu nữ còn trinh, chưa từng ăn nằm với đàn ông. Họ đem những thiếu nữ ấy về trại tại Si-lô, trong xứ Ca-na-an.
vi.R: Trong dân Gia-be Ga-la-át, họ tìm được 400 thiếu nữ chưa từng ăn nằm với đàn ông. Họ đưa những thiếu nữ ấy về trại của Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Si-lô, trong xứ Ca-na-an.

ko.L: 그들은 야베스 길르앗 주민 가운데에서 남자와 동침하여 남자를 알지 못한 젊은 처녀 사백 명을 찾아내어, 가나안 땅에 있는 실로의 진영으로 데려왔다.
ko.B: 그들은 야베스 길르앗 사람들 가운데에서 한 번도 남자와 잠자리를 한 적이 없는 젊은 처녀 사백 명을 찾아냈다. 그리고 그들을 가나안 땅에 있는 실로의 진영으로 데려왔다.
ko.R: 그들은 야베스 길르앗 사람들 가운데에서 한 번도 남자와 잠자리를 한 적이 없는 젊은 여자 사백 명을 찾아냈다. 그들은 그 여자들을 가나안 땅에 있는 실로의 이스라엘 진영으로 데려왔다.

decisions.choice: the camp at Shiloh, in the land of Canaan: the sanctuary town west of the Jordan
decisions.reason: The tent of meeting had been set up at Shiloh (Joshua 18:1), and it was still there in Samuel's youth (1 Samuel 1:3). "In the land of Canaan" sets Shiloh apart from Gilead, east of the Jordan (compare Joshua 22:9). The narrator does not say why the camp is now at Shiloh rather than Bethel.

decisions.choice: young women, virgins: unmarried girls of marriageable age
decisions.reason: The first word means a girl or young woman; the second an unmarried young woman. The clause that follows defines it: they had never had relations with a man. They are spared because they can become wives for Benjamin.

decisions.choice: who had never slept with a man
alternatives: virgins who had never slept with a man
decisions.reason: Readable keeps one plain description for the two Hebrew expressions that say the same thing.

source.text: וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ כָּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַֽיְדַבְּרוּ֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּסֶ֣לַע רִמּ֑וֹן וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם שָׁלֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent all the congregation, and they spoke to [the] sons of Benjamin who [were] at [the] rock of Rimmon, and they proclaimed to them peace.

en.L: And the whole congregation sent and spoke to the sons of Benjamin who were at the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.
en.B: Then the whole congregation sent word to the Benjaminites at the rock of Rimmon and offered them peace.
en.R: Then the whole community sent a message to the men of Benjamin at the rock of Rimmon, offering to make peace with them.

sw.L: Nayo jumuiya yote ikatuma, ikasema na wana wa Benyamini waliokuwa kwenye mwamba wa Rimoni, ikawatangazia amani.
sw.B: Kisha jumuiya yote ilituma ujumbe kwa Wabenyamini waliokuwa kwenye mwamba wa Rimoni, ikawapa amani.
sw.R: Kisha jumuiya yote ilituma ujumbe kwa watu wa Benyamini waliokuwa kwenye mwamba wa Rimoni, ikiwaomba wafanye amani.

es.L: Y toda la comunidad envió [mensajeros] y habló a los hijos de Benjamín que [estaban] en la peña de Rimón, y les proclamó paz.
es.B: Después toda la comunidad envió un mensaje a los benjamitas que estaban en la peña de Rimón y les ofreció la paz.
es.R: Después toda la comunidad envió un mensaje a los hombres de Benjamín que estaban en la peña de Rimón, ofreciéndoles hacer la paz.

fr.L: Et toute la communauté envoya parler aux fils de Benjamin qui [étaient] au rocher de Rimmôn, et ils leur proclamèrent la paix.
fr.B: Puis toute la communauté envoya un message aux Benjaminites qui étaient au rocher de Rimmôn, pour leur offrir la paix.
fr.R: Ensuite, toute la communauté a envoyé un message aux hommes de Benjamin qui étaient au rocher de Rimmôn, pour leur proposer de faire la paix.

vi.L: Toàn thể hội chúng sai người đến nói với con cháu Bên-gia-min đang ở tại tảng đá Rim-môn, và công bố hòa bình với họ.
vi.B: Bấy giờ toàn thể hội chúng sai người báo tin cho người Bên-gia-min ở tảng đá Rim-môn và đề nghị hòa bình với họ.
vi.R: Rồi cả cộng đồng gửi lời đến những người Bên-gia-min ở tảng đá Rim-môn, đề nghị làm hòa với họ.

ko.L: 온 회중이 [사람을] 보내어 림몬 바위에 있는 베냐민 자손에게 말하고 그들에게 평화를 선포하였다.
ko.B: 그런 다음 온 회중은 림몬 바위에 있는 베냐민 사람들에게 사람을 보내어 화해를 제안하였다.
ko.R: 그런 다음 온 공동체는 림몬 바위에 있는 베냐민 사람들에게 사람을 보냈다. 그들은 베냐민 사람들과 화해하고 싶다고 전했다.

decisions.choice: the rock of Rimmon: the wilderness refuge of the 600 survivors
decisions.reason: After the defeat, 600 men of Benjamin fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon and stayed there four months (20:45-47).

decisions.choice: proclaimed peace to them: declared the war over and offered terms
decisions.reason: To "call out peace" is to offer peace to an enemy (Deuteronomy 20:10). The tribes now treat Benjamin as a brother again rather than an enemy.

decisions.choice: the Benjaminites / the men of Benjamin
decisions.reason: The "sons of Benjamin" here are the 600 surviving men, so Balanced and Readable use a term for them; no gender setting is needed, since only men are meant.

source.text: וַיָּ֤שָׁב בִּנְיָמִן֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ הַנָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר חִיּ֔וּ מִנְּשֵׁ֖י יָבֵ֣שׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד וְלֹֽא־מָצְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם כֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And returned Benjamin at the time the that, and they gave to them the women whom they had kept alive from [the] women of Jabesh-gilead, and not they found for them so.

en.L: And Benjamin returned at that time, and they gave them the women whom they had kept alive from the women of Jabesh-gilead; but even so they did not find [enough] for them.
en.B: So Benjamin came back at that time, and they were given the women of Jabesh-gilead whom the Israelites had spared. But there were not enough for them all.
en.R: So the men of Benjamin came back, and the Israelites gave them the women from Jabesh-gilead whom they had let live. But there were not enough women for all of them.

sw.L: Naye Benyamini akarudi wakati huo, nao wakawapa wale wanawake waliowahifadhi hai katika wanawake wa Yabeshi-gileadi; lakini hata hivyo hawakuwapatia [wa kutosha].
sw.B: Basi Benyamini walirudi wakati huo, nao wakapewa wale wanawake wa Yabeshi-gileadi ambao Waisraeli walikuwa wamewaacha hai. Lakini hawakuwatosha wote.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo watu wa Benyamini walirudi, nao Waisraeli wakawapa wale wanawake wa Yabeshi-gileadi ambao walikuwa wamewaacha hai. Lakini wanawake hao hawakuwatosha wote.

es.L: Y volvió Benjamín en aquel tiempo, y les dieron las mujeres que habían dejado con vida de entre las mujeres de Jabés de Galaad; pero aun así no hallaron [suficientes] para ellos.
es.B: Así que Benjamín volvió en aquel tiempo, y les dieron las mujeres de Jabés de Galaad a las que los israelitas habían perdonado la vida. Pero no hubo suficientes para todos.
es.R: Así que los hombres de Benjamín volvieron, y los israelitas les dieron las mujeres de Jabés de Galaad a las que habían dejado con vida. Pero no había suficientes mujeres para todos.

fr.L: Et Benjamin revint en ce temps-là, et on leur donna les femmes qu’on avait laissées en vie parmi les femmes de Jabesh-Galaad ; mais ainsi on n’en trouva pas [assez] pour eux.
fr.B: Benjamin revint donc à ce moment-là, et on leur donna les femmes de Jabesh-Galaad que les Israélites avaient épargnées. Mais il n’y en avait pas assez pour eux tous.
fr.R: Les hommes de Benjamin sont donc revenus, et les Israélites leur ont donné les femmes de Jabesh-Galaad qu’ils avaient laissées en vie. Mais il n’y avait pas assez de femmes pour eux tous.

vi.L: Lúc ấy Bên-gia-min trở về, và người ta trao cho họ những người nữ đã được để sống trong số đàn bà Gia-be Ga-la-át; nhưng vẫn không tìm đủ cho họ.
vi.B: Vậy lúc ấy Bên-gia-min trở về, và họ được trao những người nữ Gia-be Ga-la-át mà dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã để cho sống. Nhưng không đủ cho tất cả.
vi.R: Vậy những người Bên-gia-min trở về, và dân Y-sơ-ra-ên trao cho họ những người nữ Gia-be Ga-la-át đã được để cho sống. Nhưng không đủ phụ nữ cho tất cả họ.

ko.L: 그때 베냐민이 돌아왔다. 그들이 야베스 길르앗 여자들 가운데 살려 둔 여자들을 그들에게 주었으나, 그것으로는 그들에게 [넉넉하지] 않았다.
ko.B: 그래서 베냐민 사람들이 그때 돌아왔다. 이스라엘 자손은 야베스 길르앗 여자들 가운데 살려 둔 여자들을 그들에게 주었다. 그러나 모두에게 주기에는 모자랐다.
ko.R: 그래서 베냐민 사람들이 돌아왔다. 이스라엘 백성은 야베스 길르앗에서 살려 둔 여자들을 그들에게 주었다. 그러나 모든 베냐민 사람에게 주기에는 여자들이 모자랐다.

decisions.choice: they did not find for them so: there were not enough
decisions.reason: The words are compressed: "they did not find for them thus". The sense is that this way did not provide enough wives: 400 women (verse 12) for 600 men (20:47). That shortfall leads to the plan of verses 19-22.

decisions.choice: Benjamin returned: the survivors came back from their refuge
decisions.reason: The tribe is named in the singular for its men. They return from the rock of Rimmon (verse 13), to the other tribes and to their own land.

decisions.choice: whom the Israelites had spared / the Israelites gave them
alternatives: they gave them ... whom they had kept alive
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "they". Balanced and Readable name the Israelites so that it is clear who gave the women and who received them.

source.text: וְהָעָ֥ם נִחָ֖ם לְבִנְיָמִ֑ן כִּֽי־עָשָׂ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה פֶּ֖רֶץ בְּשִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And the people had compassion for Benjamin, for had made YHWH a breach in [the] tribes of Israel.

en.L: And the people had compassion for Benjamin, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
en.B: The people grieved for Benjamin, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had torn a gap in the tribes of Israel.
en.R: The people felt sorry for the tribe of Benjamin, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had left a gap among the tribes of Israel.

sw.L: Nao watu wakamwonea huruma Benyamini, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amefanya pengo katika makabila ya Israeli.
sw.B: Watu walihuzunika kwa ajili ya Benyamini, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa ameleta pengo katika makabila ya Israeli.
sw.R: Watu waliwaonea huruma watu wa kabila la Benyamini, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa ameacha pengo kati ya makabila ya Israeli.

es.L: Y el pueblo tuvo compasión de Benjamín, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había abierto una brecha en las tribus de Israel.
es.B: El pueblo se dolió por Benjamín, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había abierto un hueco en las tribus de Israel.
es.R: El pueblo sintió lástima por la tribu de Benjamín, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dejado un hueco entre las tribus de Israel.

fr.L: Et le peuple eut pitié de Benjamin, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait fait une brèche dans les tribus d’Israël.
fr.B: Le peuple fut pris de pitié pour Benjamin, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait ouvert une brèche dans les tribus d’Israël.
fr.R: Le peuple avait pitié de la tribu de Benjamin, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait laissé un vide parmi les tribus d’Israël.

vi.L: Dân chúng thương xót Bên-gia-min, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm một chỗ vỡ trong các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Dân chúng đau lòng vì Bên-gia-min, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã để một chỗ trống bị xé ra giữa các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Dân chúng thấy thương chi tộc Bên-gia-min, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã để lại một chỗ trống giữa các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 백성은 베냐민을 불쌍히 여겼다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 지파들 가운데 틈이 생기게 하셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 백성은 베냐민 때문에 마음 아파하였다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 지파들 사이에 빈자리를 내셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 백성은 베냐민 지파를 불쌍히 여겼다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 지파들 사이에 빈자리가 생기게 하셨기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: the LORD had made a breach: the people see God's hand in Benjamin's defeat
decisions.reason: The narrator had said that the LORD struck Benjamin before Israel (20:35). The breach is still the result of human choices as well: Benjamin's defense of Gibeah, the army's slaughter, and the oath. The verse holds both together.

decisions.choice: breach: a break, as in a wall, where something is missing
decisions.reason: The word is used for a gap broken in a city wall (1 Kings 11:27) and for the LORD's breaking out against Uzzah (2 Samuel 6:8). Here the gap is a missing tribe among the twelve.

decisions.choice: had compassion: the same feeling as in verse 6
decisions.reason: The verse takes up verse 6 again and marks a new start: the 400 women were not enough, and the people's grief drives a second plan.

source.text: וַיֹּֽאמְר֨וּ זִקְנֵ֣י הָעֵדָ֔ה מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים לְנָשִׁ֑ים כִּֽי־נִשְׁמְדָ֥ה מִבִּנְיָמִ֖ן אִשָּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said [the] elders of the congregation, what shall we do for the ones remaining for wives, for destroyed from Benjamin [is the] woman?

en.L: And the elders of the congregation said, "What shall we do for those who remain, for wives, since the women of Benjamin have been destroyed?"
en.B: Then the elders of the congregation said, "How can we provide wives for the men who are left, since the women of Benjamin have been wiped out?"
en.R: The elders of the community asked, "How can we find wives for the men who are left? All the women of Benjamin have been killed."

sw.L: Nao wazee wa jumuiya wakasema, "Tuwafanyie nini wale waliosalia, kwa ajili ya wake, kwa kuwa wanawake wameangamizwa katika Benyamini?"
sw.B: Kisha wazee wa jumuiya walisema, "Tutawapatiaje wake wale watu waliosalia, kwa kuwa wanawake wa Benyamini wameangamizwa?"
sw.R: Wazee wa jumuiya waliuliza, "Tutawapatiaje wake wale watu waliosalia? Wanawake wote wa Benyamini wameuawa."

es.L: Y dijeron los ancianos de la comunidad: «¿Qué haremos por los que han quedado, en cuanto a mujeres, ya que han sido exterminadas las mujeres de Benjamín?».
es.B: Entonces los ancianos de la comunidad dijeron: «¿Cómo conseguiremos esposas para los hombres que han quedado, si las mujeres de Benjamín han sido exterminadas?».
es.R: Los ancianos de la comunidad preguntaron: «¿Cómo podemos conseguir esposas para los hombres que han quedado? Todas las mujeres de Benjamín han muerto».

fr.L: Et les anciens de la communauté dirent : « Que ferons-nous pour ceux qui restent, pour [leur trouver] des femmes, puisque les femmes ont été détruites de Benjamin ? »
fr.B: Les anciens de la communauté dirent alors : « Comment fournir des femmes aux hommes qui restent, puisque les femmes de Benjamin ont été exterminées ? »
fr.R: Les anciens de la communauté ont demandé : « Comment trouver des femmes pour les hommes qui restent ? Toutes les femmes de Benjamin ont été tuées. »

vi.L: Các trưởng lão của hội chúng nói: "Chúng ta phải làm gì cho những người còn sót lại về việc vợ, vì đàn bà Bên-gia-min đã bị tiêu diệt?"
vi.B: Bấy giờ các trưởng lão của hội chúng nói: "Làm sao chúng ta có thể lo vợ cho những người còn sót lại, vì đàn bà Bên-gia-min đã bị tiêu diệt hết?"
vi.R: Các trưởng lão của cộng đồng hỏi: "Làm sao chúng ta tìm được vợ cho những người còn sót lại? Tất cả đàn bà Bên-gia-min đã bị giết."

ko.L: 회중의 장로들이 말했다. "베냐민에서 여자들이 멸절되었으니, 남은 자들에게 아내를 얻어 주려면 어떻게 해야 하겠느냐?"
ko.B: 그러자 회중의 장로들이 말했다. "베냐민의 여자들이 다 죽었으니, 살아남은 남자들에게 어떻게 아내를 구해 줄 수 있겠느냐?"
ko.R: 공동체의 장로들이 물었다. "살아남은 남자들에게 어떻게 아내를 구해 줄 수 있겠느냐? 베냐민의 여자들은 모두 죽었다."

decisions.choice: the women have been destroyed from Benjamin: killed when the towns were struck
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "woman" in the singular, meaning women as a whole. Israel's army killed everyone found in Benjamin's towns, people and animals, and burned the towns (20:48).

decisions.choice: the elders of the congregation: the heads of families who led the assembly
decisions.reason: The elders were the senior men who spoke and decided for the people (Exodus 3:16; Judges 11:5). The question repeats verse 7, now from the leaders, and leads to their plan.

ko.L: 그들이 말했다. "베냐민의 살아남은 자들에게 유산이 [있어야 한다]. 그래야 이스라엘에서 한 지파가 지워지지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그들이 말했다. "베냐민의 살아남은 사람들에게 유산을 이을 자손이 있어야 한다. 그래야 이스라엘에서 한 지파가 지워지지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그들이 말했다. "아직 살아 있는 베냐민 사람들은 자기 땅을 물려받을 자녀를 낳아야 한다. 그래야 이스라엘에서 한 지파가 사라지지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: an inheritance for the survivors: the remnant of Benjamin must keep its land through heirs
alternatives: "How can there be an inheritance for the survivors of Benjamin?"
"The land of Benjamin belongs to its survivors"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is brief: "a possession of escaped ones for Benjamin". The likely sense is that the tribe's land must stay with its survivors and pass to their children, so that Benjamin goes on as a tribe. It may also be a question, "How can the survivors keep an inheritance?", or a statement that the land still belongs to them. The wording is hard, and the sense here follows what the elders go on to plan.

decisions.choice: wiped out from Israel: erased like a name from a record
decisions.reason: The verb means to wipe clean or blot out. A family line was said to be blotted out when no heir carried on its name (Deuteronomy 25:6). Here a whole tribe is in danger of it.

decisions.choice: must have heirs to keep their inheritance / must have children to keep their land
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the sense of the short phrase explicit, following meaning decision m1. Another reading is possible (see m1).

decisions.choice: Cursed is the one who gives: an oath backed by a curse
decisions.reason: The oath of verse 1 called down a curse on anyone who broke it, as Saul's oath did on anyone who ate during the battle (1 Samuel 14:24, 28). To give a daughter to a Benjaminite would bring the curse on the father.

decisions.choice: the reason clause is part of the elders' speech
alternatives: the narrator's comment: "For the Israelites had sworn ..."
decisions.reason: The elders speak of the oath in the third person, "the Israelites have sworn", which could also be the narrator's comment. It is read here as their own words, since it explains why "we cannot". The Hebrew has no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: to a man from Benjamin
decisions.reason: As in verse 1, Readable says what "Benjamin" means here: a man of the tribe.

es.R: Entonces dijeron: «Cada año hay una fiesta para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en Silo». (Silo está al norte del pueblo de Betel y al sur de Lebona. Queda al este del camino principal que va de Betel a Siquem).

fr.B: Ils dirent alors : « Il y a chaque année une fête {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Silo. » (Silo se trouve au nord de Béthel et au sud de Lebona, à l’est de la route qui monte de Béthel à Sichem.)
fr.R: Ensuite, ils ont dit : « Chaque année, il y a une fête en l’honneur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Silo. » (Silo est au nord de la ville de Béthel et au sud de Lebona. Elle est à l’est de la grande route qui va de Béthel à Sichem.)

decisions.choice: the festival of the LORD: a yearly feast, perhaps at the grape harvest
alternatives: a local yearly festival at Shiloh
decisions.reason: Which festival is meant is not said. The vineyards and the dancing (verses 20-21) suggest the harvest of grapes, which fits the Festival of Booths in autumn (Leviticus 23:34-43; Deuteronomy 16:13-15). It may also be a local yearly feast at Shiloh like the one Elkanah attended (1 Samuel 1:3).

decisions.choice: from days to days: every year
decisions.reason: "From days to days" is a set phrase for a yearly event (1 Samuel 1:3; 2:19).

decisions.choice: the directions to Shiloh are the narrator's note
decisions.reason: The elders and the Benjaminites would have known where Shiloh was. The precise directions read like a note for later readers who did not, so they are set outside the quotation. The Hebrew has no quotation marks, and they could also be part of the elders' words.

decisions.choice: parentheses, and "Shiloh" named again
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins the directions with "which". Setting them in parentheses and naming Shiloh shows that the narrator is speaking, following m3.

decisions.choice: they commanded: the plural the Hebrew text tells readers to read
decisions.reason: The written letters of the Hebrew text give "he commanded", while the marginal reading of the Masoretes, which the vowels follow, gives "they commanded". The plural fits the elders who speak in verses 16-19. The meaning of the verse is the same either way.

decisions.choice: lie in wait: set an ambush
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for an ambush in war, as in the attack on Gibeah (20:29, 33, 36-38). The Benjaminites are told to hide and wait for their moment.

ko.L: 지켜보아라. 보아라, 실로의 딸들이 춤추러 나오면, 포도원에서 나와 실로의 딸들 가운데에서 저마다 자기 아내를 붙잡아 베냐민 땅으로 가거라.
